analysis.intent_details: Welcome message and account confirmation for new SignalHire user

responses.subject: Re: Thank you for signing up for SignalHire
responses.body:
Dear SignalHire Team,

Thank you for the confirmation email regarding my recent sign-up. I appreciate the prompt acknowledgment of my registration.

Please let me know if there are any additional steps I need to take to complete the onboarding process or if you require any further information from my end.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
responses.rationale: This response acknowledges the sign-up confirmation while opening the door for any additional steps needed, maintaining a professional tone appropriate for a business service.

responses.subject: Re: Thank you for signing up for SignalHire
responses.body:
To Whom It May Concern,

I hereby acknowledge receipt of your email confirming my successful registration with SignalHire. I look forward to utilizing your services.

Should you require any further information or documentation, please do not hesitate to contact me.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
responses.rationale: This formal response simply acknowledges the confirmation without requesting additional information, suitable when no further action is needed.

responses.subject: Re: Thank you for signing up for SignalHire

Hi there,

Thanks for the confirmation email! I'm excited to get started with SignalHire.

Is there anything else I need to do to get set up, or am I good to go?
